title: PlasmaZones Animation Shader Metadata
description: metadata.json for a bundled or user animation-shader pack. Core identity and the parameter contract are enforced. A pack may declare no parameters, and AnimationShaderEffect::toJson leaves the key out then. The optional rendering keys (vertexShader, fboExtent, textures, appliesTo, geometryGrid, preview), the audio and multipass keys (audio, multipass, bufferShaders, bufferScale, bufferWrap, bufferWraps, bufferFilter, bufferFilters, bufferFeedback, depthBuffer, wallpaper), the named parameter presets and the descriptive metadata (description, author, version, category) are type-checked, so a wrong-typed value is rejected at the gate rather than swallowed by a typed accessor at load. Unknown top-level keys are still accepted rather than rejected, so this schema will not catch a mis-spelled key such as "preset" for "presets". The loader ignores anything it does not know. Like fboExtent and appliesTo, the buffer wrap and filter tokens are type-checked only, because the loader warns about an unknown token and keeps the pack. There is no per-pass bufferScales list here. That is surface-only, and one bufferScale covers the whole chain.

fboExtent.description: Which rect the effect's FBO spans. "anchor" is the captured window, and is what an absent key means. "surface" is the whole surface, which a pack needs when it draws outside the window's own bounds. The loader matches both spellings case-insensitively, treats an empty string as absent, and warns and falls back on anything else. The key is type-checked only, on purpose, because an enum here would drop a pack the loader would have run.

textures.description: Image textures the pack declares. Slot N feeds uTexture<N+1>, because uTexture0 is the window's own content, and that slot's pixel size arrives at iTextureResolution[N+1]. Paths are pack-relative and are containment-checked at load. The list is type-checked only, on purpose. The loader caps the list and drops an entry with an empty path, warning about each, and it ignores a key it does not know, so a cap or a required-path rule here would drop a pack the loader would have run.

appliesTo.description: Event classes this pack offers itself for: geometry, appearance, desktop, move, strip or tab. An absent key, or one that validates down to empty, means universal, which is everywhere except the four opt-in classes desktop, move, strip and tab. It is type-checked only, on purpose. The loader drops an unknown token with a warning and keeps the pack, where an enum here would drop the pack instead.

geometryGrid.description: Vertex-grid subdivisions, for a pack whose vertex stage displaces geometry. Absent or zero means the pack is drawn on a plain quad. A negative value is allowed, on purpose, because the loader clamps it with qBound(0, value, max) to 0, which is the documented way to say no grid. The bounds are the range of an int, which is what the loader reads. A larger value would read as 0.

audio.description: The pack samples the CAVA spectrum through data/animations/shared/audio.glsl. This flag is what keys the compositor's CAVA run-gate. The daemon reads it nowhere, including in its own run-gate, so an audio animation pack hosted by the daemon can be fed a spectrum that was never started.

bufferShaders.description: Buffer pass sources, in pass order. The runtime binds at most 8 (AnimationShaderContract::kMaxBufferPasses). Unlike a bad token, a surplus pass is refused here. The loader would drop it with a warning, and the effect would render without it.

bufferScale.description: Render scale for the WHOLE buffer chain. Bounds track PhosphorShaders::kMinBufferScale and kMaxBufferScale.

bufferWrap.description: clamp, repeat or mirror. The loader resets an unknown token to the runtime default, with a warning.

bufferWraps.description: Per-buffer wrap, aligned with bufferShaders: clamp, repeat or mirror, or an empty string for the default of that buffer. The loader resets an unknown token to the default and drops entries past the buffer list, each with a warning.

bufferFilter.description: linear, nearest or mipmap. The loader resets an unknown token to the runtime default, with a warning.

bufferFilters.description: Per-buffer filter, aligned with bufferShaders: linear, nearest or mipmap, or an empty string for the default of that buffer. The loader resets an unknown token to the default and drops entries past the buffer list, each with a warning.

presets.description: Named parameter presets. Each value is a map of parameter id to value, naming a subset of the pack's declared parameters. A preset id is its key here, and it is also the label the picker shows, so it has to read as a name. That rules out control and bidi-formatting characters, and anything longer than a label can show. Unlike a user preset id it never becomes a filename, because duplicating a pack preset mints a fresh UUID. A null value is allowed and means the preset says nothing about that parameter, so it keeps the pack's default, and the loader drops the entry. Those rules are checked by plasmazones-shader-validate rather than here, with ShaderPreset::isUsableId, the predicate the picker relies on. It refuses every control and formatting character, path separators, a leading dot and a blank id, and it measures length in UTF-16 units. A pattern could state some of these, but not the whole set of control and formatting characters, since neither Python nor the runtime validator matches character categories. And maxLength counts code points where the picker counts UTF-16 units.

type.description: Marshalling type of the uniform. An unknown type cannot be bound, so it is rejected.

default.description: Default value. Use a string for color (#rrggbb), a number for float or int, and a boolean for bool.
